text: The Terms of Reference for the Toronto Music Advisory Committee (TMAC) state that at the call of the Chair, TMAC will hold up to four meetings per year. The following meetings of the Toronto Music Advisory Committee have been scheduled: Date: February 20, 2020 Time: 2:30 p.m. Location: Committee Room 2 Date: May 13, 2020 Time: 10:00 a.m. Location: Committee Room 1 Date: September 24, 2020 Time: 2:30 p.m. Location: Committee Room 2 Date: November 16, 2020 Time: 2:30 p.m. Location: Committee Room 2 Meetings will be held at Toronto City Hall, 100 Queen Street West.
The Toronto Music Advisory Committee received the item for information.
